title: Disproved beliefs ledger
hypothesis: Pinning what the game has already contradicted, each entry pairing the model's own pursuit (a move a script pushed back, or a sentence placing a story character on a tile) with the game's evidence (the script's pages, the readout's Not on this map line, the dialogue naming the character), stops the model repeating disproved beliefs (run 2026-10-16T02-23-17_qwen36-gpu1_sh02: Birch sought on lab tiles after 'The PROF's away on fieldwork', 15 presses into the twin's push-back, 47 into Birch's 'Don't leave me'), so more runs reach the rival's house in fewer turns.
notes: Uses the incumbent of readout-rules-in-prompt with explorer-guidance-v1, connection-edge-tiles-v1, in-game-naming-readout-v1, no-nickname-guidance-v1, battle-text-auto-advance-v1 and both new switches explicitly off (every registry switch explicit, in registry order). Activation: entries need an overworld readout or a script push-back, first possible in the truck after the name is confirmed; on sh02 the first entry was Mom's push-back at T59. Measured on sh02 (snapshot to turn 1009): 4 entries, 4 true contradictions; delivered on 206 model calls. Joins the bundle arm of bundle-v-control (operator decision 2026-10-16; the bundle file is edited by its own thread). Provisional source.commit is the branch head; repinned to the merge SHA when it lands. Review round 1: the incumbent turns on character-presence-v1 and dialogue-auto-advance-v1 (both on in sh02 and in the bundle arms), the ledger's two entry sources, so the treatment is not inert; it therefore differs from the shared incumbent in those two switches.
